Title: Subscribe with a new valid email
Preconditions: Visitor on page with signup form; email not yet subscribed
Steps:
1. Enter the email in the Email field
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Success confirmation shown (text per assumption A1); subscription record created for new.user@example.com; no error displayed

Title: Show Already subscribed for duplicate email
Expected Result: Message "Already subscribed" displayed; no second record created; no success message

Title: Subscribe with email containing plus-tag and subdomain
Expected Result: Accepted as valid format; success confirmation shown; record stored with the exact address

Title: Submit using Enter key in email field
Steps:
1. Enter the email
2. Press Enter instead of clicking Subscribe
Expected Result: Form submits once; same success confirmation as clicking Subscribe

Title: Reject empty email on Subscribe
Expected Result: Validation error shown on Email field; no request creates a subscription; no success message

Title: Reject email missing @ symbol
Expected Result: Invalid-email validation error shown; no subscription created

Title: Reject script injection in email field
Expected Result: Rejected as invalid format; no script executes; input is HTML-escaped in any echoed message; nothing stored

Title: Reject SQL injection string in email field
Expected Result: Rejected as invalid (or handled safely); no DB error or stack trace shown; subscriber table unchanged

Title: Reject email missing domain part
Expected Result: Invalid-email validation error shown; no subscription created

Title: Reject email with multiple @ or spaces inside
Steps:
1. Enter first email, click Subscribe
2. Repeat with second email
Expected Result: Both rejected with invalid-email error; no subscription created

Title: Double-click Subscribe creates only one subscription
Steps:
1. Enter the email
2. Double-click Subscribe rapidly
Expected Result: Exactly one subscription record; user sees a single success message (button disabled while submitting, or second call returns duplicate handled gracefully)

Title: Detect duplicate regardless of letter case
Steps:
1. Enter the mixed-case email
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: "Already subscribed" shown; no new record (assumption A2: comparison is case-insensitive)

Title: Trim leading and trailing spaces before validation and duplicate check
Steps:
1. Enter the email with surrounding spaces
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Spaces trimmed; treated as duplicate and "Already subscribed" shown (assumption A3)

Title: Network failure during submit shows recoverable error
Preconditions: Email not yet subscribed; network can be throttled/offline
Steps:
1. Enter the email
2. Go offline
3. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Generic error shown (not success); entered email retained; retry after reconnect succeeds

Title: Different email after a duplicate still subscribes
Steps:
1. Replace email with other.user@example.com
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Previous message cleared; success confirmation shown; new record created

Title: Internationalized (unicode) email handling
Expected Result: Behaviour matches the agreed policy (open question Q2): either accepted and stored intact, or rejected with invalid-email error; no crash or garbled data

Title: Accept email of exactly 100 characters (max)
Expected Result: Accepted; success confirmation; full 100-char address stored untruncated

Title: Reject email of 101 characters (max+1)
Steps:
1. Enter (or paste) the 101-char email
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Either input blocks the 101st char (maxlength=100) or a max-length error is shown; no subscription created; value not silently truncated and saved

Title: Accept email of exactly 99 characters
Expected Result: Accepted; success confirmation; full 99-char address stored untruncated

Title: Accept shortest plausible valid email
Expected Result: Accepted as valid format; success confirmation shown
